reward_model.spec: the bench reward spec — performance class, BOUNDED log form
reward_model.name: reward_md_log_speedup_v2_oracle_zero
reward_model.formula: reward = min(1.0, ln(speedup/ref_speedup)/ln(ref_speedup)) if speedup > ref_speedup else 0.0; range [0,1]
reward_model.speedup_definition: baseline_bpb / median_val_bpb  (held-out bits-per-byte at a FIXED TRAINING-TOKEN budget, median over the harness seed set; lower bpb is better, so the ratio is >1 only when the candidate beats the tuned-AdamW recipe it started from)
reward_model.semantic_caveat: `speedup` / `ref_speedup` carry a QUALITY ratio, not a wall-clock ratio. Nothing in this task is timed for score — the wall-clock is only a feasibility guard and the BUDGET is tokens. reward.md's bounded log envelope is ratio-agnostic; only the variable name says latency. The field names are kept for schema compatibility and are described by metric_kind / metric_name / metric_direction / timing_measured.
reward_model.baseline_bpb_status: CALIBRATED ON H20 2026-07-27: median of 5 runs of the SHIPPED starter through the shipped harness (values [1.7036998866199995, 1.7021411251584952, 1.7051986273928117, 1.7010994296767377, 1.7020227068179146]), spread 0.004099 bpb (0.241%), cv 0.00095. FROZEN constant; the scorer never runs the baseline.
reward_model.ref_speedup_status: CALIBRATED ON H20 2026-07-27: baseline median / oracle median = 1.204528 from 5 baseline and 5 oracle runs, INTERLEAVED A/B in one session. Oracle values [1.409003292011136, 1.4127749101779128, 1.4307412643520512, 1.4236769838932675, 1.4131193202327261], spread 0.021738 bpb (1.538%), cv 0.00637. Clears reward.md's 1.15 authoring floor; worst-case pairing under the observed spread is 1.188964. FROZEN constant; the oracle is NOT in the image and is NEVER run at scoring time.
reward_model.fail_closed: when baseline_bpb or ref_speedup is absent / <= 1 / below the authoring floor the run is a HARD FAIL with reason `ref_speedup_invalid_or_missing`; it is NEVER silently treated as 1.0.
reward_model.hardware_and_data_caveat: baseline_bpb=1.7021411251584952 与 ref_speedup=1.204527530540146 均在 H20 上、且在 task/environment/Dockerfile 里那份 WikiText-103-raw + SentencePiece-BPE-8192 语料上标定。 若你的 GPU 不是 H20,或重建语料的指纹(build 日志里打印的 tokenizer.model / train.bin sha256)与已知良好构建不一致,这两个常量就不再可比 —— 请按 recalibrate_howto 重新标定后再计分。 参考实现:强基线 task/solution/strong_baseline/,oracle task/solution/ceiling/(reviewer-only,不进镜像)。

recalibrate_howto.why: reward = min(1, ln((baseline_bpb/val_bpb)/ref_speedup)/ln(ref_speedup)), 且 (baseline_bpb/val_bpb) <= ref_speedup 时为 0;两个常量是标定值,判分时只读、不重跑参考实现。
recalibrate_howto.note: 计分路径故意不接受 VERIFIER_MODE(反作弊),因此重标定的做法是把参考实现挂成 candidate 来跑。
recalibrate_howto.step3_read: 从 /logs/verifier/benchmark_results.json 取 val_bpb(建议各跑 >=3 次取中位数)
recalibrate_howto.step4_write: 写回本文件 reward_model.baseline_bpb = 强基线中位数;reward_model.ref_speedup = baseline_bpb / oracle 中位数
recalibrate_howto.guard: ref_speedup <= 1 或缺失 => 设计上 HARD FAIL 0;authoring floor 为 1.15

lever: SAMPLE EFFICIENCY at a FIXED TRAINING-TOKEN budget (A4 优化器算法 + architecture + data schedule). The budget is TOKENS, not wall-clock, which STRUCTURALLY zeroes every throughput lever the sibling family-A tasks grade (fp8, torch.compile, batch tuning, a faster loader buy nothing when the budget is tokens). The only way to a lower held-out val_bpb is to extract more learning per token: the optimizer/update rule (Muon-style spectral updates), the architecture (RMSNorm/RoPE/QK-norm/ReLU^2/zero-init/logit-softcap), and the data schedule.

budget.kind: TRAINING TOKENS (the budget). Enforced BY CONSTRUCTION, not by a counter: the harness slices exactly token_budget tokens from the digest-pinned corpus into a per-seed shard, points DATA_PATH at it, and chmod-000 quarantines the full corpus for the duration of the scored run, so no recipe can consume more tokens than the budget. Nothing is trusted from the candidate; no in-loop token counter is believed. Restored after every seed.
budget.wallclock_note: A FEASIBILITY GUARD, NOT the budget — deliberately generous so a slower-but-smarter recipe is never penalised. MEASURED: the tuned-AdamW anchor needs ~76 s and the record-style ceiling ~114 s per seed at the 24M budget; the 900 s guard is ~8x/12x those. Enforced by an EXTERNAL hard kill (setsid process group -> SIGTERM -> SIGKILL at guard+grace), never a cooperative in-loop timer.

seed_policy: The harness FIXES the seed set (not solver-selectable) and scores the MEDIAN val_bpb over seeds -> kills the seed lottery.

quality_gate.param_cap_why: At a fixed TOKEN budget a bigger model is monotonically better, so without a cap the task would reward buying HBM instead of sample efficiency. The harness RE-COUNTS parameters from the reloaded artifact, never a self-report. The floor blocks a degenerate tiny model. The reference recipes sit at ~29.6M, leaving real architectural room inside the cap.
quality_gate.min_plausible_val_bpb_note: ANTI-SPOOF / ANTI-CONTAMINATION floor, tightened from 0.30. No honest recipe trained from scratch on 24M tokens at this parameter scale reaches 1.00 bpb on the held-out split (the demonstrated in-budget ceiling is ~1.41), so a value below the floor means a forged loss or held-out contamination, not a better model. Firing this check is reported as `anti_cheat_triggered`.
quality_gate.note: parameter-golf anti-spoof kit, verbatim: a real LM scores real held-out text << arbitrary ids; forward(x,y) loss == CE(forward(x),y); logits vary across positions; >=1M params; val_bpb inside a plausibility band. Every check is HARD under the bounded reward (the quality floor used to be soft-tagged). A TRUNCATED suite (fewer checks than expected_total_checks = 1 + 7*n_seeds + 2 (= 24 at 3 seeds, exactly the pre-modification suite size)) can never score above 0 (`gate_suite_incomplete`).

smuggled_checkpoint_block.staging_strip: the training entry runs from an ISOLATED staging dir holding source files only: every *.pt/*.pth/*.bin/*.safetensors/*.ckpt/*.npz/*.npy/*.pkl/*.h5/*.onnx/*.gguf and every file >8 MB is withheld, so there is no pre-baked artifact to hand back.
smuggled_checkpoint_block.cross_seed_divergence: the harness trains >=3 seeds and requires >=3 DISTINCT checkpoint sha256 digests; byte-identical weights across seeds => reward 0 (real training on different seeds cannot produce identical weights). This catches a smuggled/cached checkpoint even if it evaded the strip.
smuggled_checkpoint_block.negative_control: solution/negative/train_gpt.py is REVIEWER-ONLY (and no longer baked into the image) and exercises exactly this cheat; it MUST score 0.

anti_tamper.frozen_surface_fingerprint: the scorer sha256s EVERY file in /tests before each training call and re-checks after it returns. Any content change => `anti_cheat_triggered` + `forbidden_edit_path`; any mode change or unexpected new file in /tests => `anti_cheat_triggered`.
anti_tamper.quarantine: /tests is chmod 0000 for the duration of every training call, so the held-out corpus and the calibrated constants are unreadable while the candidate's code runs.
anti_tamper.env_override_removed: the scorer used to honour E2E_BUDGET_SECONDS_OVERRIDE / E2E_TOKEN_BUDGET_OVERRIDE / E2E_N_SEEDS_OVERRIDE and E2E_STRONG_BASELINE_BPB_OVERRIDE — i.e. the reward's own anchor was settable from the environment, and the container entrypoint is a LOGIN shell that sources the solver-owned ~/.bashrc. All four are GONE; test.sh additionally unsets every E2E_* variable before scoring.
anti_tamper.mode_dispatch_removed: test.sh used to copy a reviewer recipe into /app/submission when VERIFIER_MODE was set, reading it from the baked /opt/strong_baseline — an environment-settable backdoor into the graded tree. The scored path now grades /app/submission and nothing else, and a non-candidate VERIFIER_MODE is itself a hard fail.
anti_tamper.residual: the training entry runs as uid 0 in the same container, so a determined root solver can chmod /tests back and read the held-out corpus. That is DETECTED (mode change) but not PREVENTED. Full prevention requires running the training entry under an unprivileged uid.
anti_tamper.training_uid_note: The candidate's train_for_budget runs as uid 65534 (nobody), NOT root. This is what makes BOTH quarantines real: chmod 0000 is ignored by uid 0, so without the drop a root recipe could open the FULL corpus at /data/datasets/wikitext_bpe8k/train.bin and train on far more than token_budget tokens (defeating 'enforced by construction'), and could read the held-out corpus it is scored on. The harness grants the unprivileged uid write access to its staging dir + out_dir and read access to the budgeted shard, and nothing else; the child reports the euid it ACTUALLY ran under (training_privileges in metrics.json) so the record is the truth rather than the intent. Set to null to disable.

held_out.identity: canonical WikiText-103 TEST split (1,281,873 bytes) — the SAME validated holdout the sibling training tasks use. Uploaded FRESH at scoring and NO LONGER BAKED into the image (it was baked at /opt/verifier/holdout_corpus.txt in :v2, readable at uid 0).
held_out.eval: stabilized median-of-3-shifted-passes, fp32 cross-entropy, bits-per-byte via SentencePiece byte-LUTs (parameter-golf eval machinery, lifted verbatim)

data_loader_checksum.note: the corpus digest is pinned and the scored shard is cut from it; the loader IMPLEMENTATION is open (order/packing/curriculum are levers) but its byte content is pinned.

entry_contract.training: /app/submission/train_gpt.py :: train_for_budget(seed, out_dir, budget_seconds) -> must write <out_dir>/model_ckpt.pt. Harness env: SEED, TOKEN_BUDGET, MAX_WALLCLOCK_SEC, MAX_PARAMS, OUT_CKPT, DATA_PATH (= the budgeted shard), TOKENIZER_PATH, NANOGPT_REPO.
entry_contract.reload: /app/submission/train_gpt.py :: load_model_for_verification(checkpoint_path, device) -> nn.Module or (args, model) honoring model(x)->logits (B,T,V) and model(x,y)->scalar CE loss.

editable_area: the whole /app/repo (nanoGPT -- the model, attention, and training code are all fair game) + /app/submission, minus the frozen surface.

provenance.harness_lifted_from: the sub-quadratic-LM sibling task's compute_reward.py (itself from the parameter-golf task family): the eval, anti-spoof kit, isolated-staging strip, external hard kill and cross-seed divergence gate are reused verbatim; the A6 sub-quadratic-scaling gate is REPLACED by this task's parameter cap, and the wall-clock budget is REPLACED by the token budget.
provenance.public_references_allowed: KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt (the record trajectory + its git history), kellerjordan.github.io/posts/muon, karpathy/nanoGPT. The METHOD is public and allowed; what is protected is the MEASUREMENT.
